name: TimeSeriesStatsResponse
description:
Response object for the timeseries stats/aggregation endpoint.
This provides aggregated IP counts over time intervals matching
a GNQL query.

count.description: The sum of all IP counts across all time intervals

min.description: The minimum IP count observed in any single time interval

max.description: The maximum IP count observed in any single time interval

data.description: Array of aggregated data points, one per time interval
